listing.name: Ridge Racer 6 (Ridge Racer 6 Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows package and disc-import launcher Limits: Early Windows test release; Linux test-channel metadata is not a stable player-route pass. Upstream platforms: Windows10/11 x86-64 portable ZIP; separate experimental Linux test channel exists, selected Linux artifact CPU not established by frozen release evidence. Original data: Own USA Xbox 360 Ridge Racer 6 disc, title 4E4D07D3, as ISO. RR6 Launcher checks and extracts the disc once; the ISO is then unnecessary. Other regions are not accepted. Exact accepted default.xex revision/hash is not established by the reviewed README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
